sections.title: A laptop-sized Shakespeare GPT
sections.pseudocode:
Train shakespeare_char with context 256, batch 64, one accumulation step, and a 6-layer model of width 384.
Drop out at 0.2, learn at 1e-3 for 5000 steps, and decay to 1e-4.
Score every 250 steps with 200 batches, log every 10 steps, and save only when validation improves.
Use Adam's second moment 0.99 and warm up for 100 steps.
# Insight: This is the small run: one GPU, a few minutes, character-level Shakespeare.

sections.title: A laptop-sized Shakespeare GPT
sections.pseudocode:
Write this run to out-shakespeare-char.
Score every 250 steps, using 200 batches.
Log every 10 steps.
Save a checkpoint only when validation improves.
Leave the run log off.
Name the log shakespeare-char and the run mini-gpt, if you turn it on.
Train on the shakespeare_char dataset.
Use one micro-batch step, a batch of 64, and context 256.
Use 6 layers, 6 heads, and width 384.
Drop out with probability 0.2.
Learn at 1e-3 for 5000 steps.
Decay the rate over those same 5000 steps, down to 1e-4.
Use a second Adam moment of 0.99.
Warm up for 100 steps.
# Insight: These assignments replace train.py globals only because configurator.py executes this file.
# Context: Context 256 is 256 characters, not 256 GPT-2 pieces. The model is much smaller than the 12-layer default.
